column1: # Lamakan: the caravan wakes and the party splits.

column3: Isaac, the caravan. Forty\nof them, all waking at\nonce.{end_wait}
They're coming for the\nlight, Isaac. We should\nturn back.{end_wait}
Turn back? Burn them where\nthey stand. It's cleaner.{end_wait}
They aren't afraid of us.\nThey're afraid of what's\nin their own heads.{end_wait}
Then you'll die calming\nthem. I won't watch.{end_wait}
Keep up, Isaac. I'll walk\npoint. Kalay won't wait.{end_wait}
She won't look back at us,\nIsaac. Not once.{end_wait}
